name: Groq
description: Groq is an AI inference platform that provides fast, low-latency access to large language models via its custom Language Processing Unit (LPU) silicon and the GroqCloud API.
bestFor: Developers seeking fast, low-latency LLM inference
Teams needing scalable, cost-effective AI deployment
Organizations requiring on-premise or private cloud AI solutions
strengths: Custom-built LPU for deterministic, low-latency inference
Flexible deployment options (public, private, co-cloud, on-premise)
gettingStarted: Visit console.groq.com/keys to create an API key.
Set the GROQ_API_KEY environment variable in your terminal: export GROQ_API_KEY=<your-api-key-here>.
Install the Groq Python library: pip install groq.
Make your first chat completion request using the Python client or a tool like curl.
usageNotes: Free tier is rate-limited (e.g., around 30 requests per minute, 6,000 tokens per minute on most models).
Paid Developer Tier offers higher rate limits (up to 10x the free tier), batch processing at a 25% discount, and access to the Flex Tier.
The Flex Tier (beta) provides 10x rate limits on selected models with on-demand processing.
Enterprise tier offers custom models, regional endpoints, dedicated support, and LoRA fine-tuning.
Compound is an agentic AI system available on GroqCloud that integrates web search, code execution, browser automation, and Wolfram Alpha.
priceDetails: Free tier available. Paid Developer Tier offers pay-as-you-go token-based pricing. Input token prices range from $0.05 per million tokens (Llama 3.1 8B) to $0.59 per million tokens (Llama 3.3 70B), with output tokens at $0.08 to $0.79 per million.

commands.label: Python chat completion
commands.command: from groq import Groq; client = Groq(api_key=os.environ.get("GROQ_API_KEY")); chat_completion = client.chat.completions.create(messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Explain the importance of fast language models"}], model="llama-3.3-70b-versatile"); print(chat_completion.choices[0].message.content)
